notes: Ballot lists: Ballotpedia pages came back empty and the PA DOS list was not found. Lineups are from iVoterGuide 2026 general race pages and City & State PA (2026-05-22); PA-6 also matches Chester Co's unofficial 2026 general list (2026-08-06). No minor-party or independent candidates found; confirm against the PA DOS certified list.

2026 roll calls (11, 65, 69, 280): member-level votes come from watch.vote, which mirrors House Clerk data, because clerk.house.gov returned 403. The clerk URLs for these are built from the roll numbers and were not loaded. The 2021 and 2025 votes were read on clerk.house.gov itself.
Roll 69 = House amendment to S.1383 carrying the SAVE America Act (photo ID to vote + proof of citizenship), passed 218-213 on 2026-02-11. H.R.22 (2025) covered citizenship proof only, not photo ID.

H.R.7008 (2026-07-22, 232-198) combined a ban on new stock purchases by members with a photo-voter-ID requirement, so a NAY is not clean opposition to a stock ban. Not used to set any term-limits stance.
Gun records (H.R.8, 2021) and abortion records (H.R.3755, 2021) are from the 117th Congress; Summer Lee was not yet in office.
Stance-from-record is used only for direct matches: OBBBA = medicaid-cuts, H.R.1834 = aca, H.J.Res.72 = tariffs (Canada only), SAVE America = voter-id, H.R.8 = guns, WHPA = abortion.
Old sources: Hayes 2024 survey; Meuser abortion 2018; Houlahan abortion 2022 (that page now returns 404, URL from search index); Meuser tariffs May 2025.

Questionnaires: Houlahan, Meuser, Smucker, Wallace and Mannion left the 2026 iVoterGuide survey blank. iVoterGuide is a conservative-affiliated guide, but the answers used are the candidates' own words.

Not reachable: Capital-Star 2026 voter guide pages (403; Hayes answered there, Lee did not answer Q1), Vote411, and a PA-11 Smucker-Mannion debate listed on Wikipedia but not read. Coverage likely improves with these. Search budget ran out before the Houlahan, Wallace, Hayes and Lee gaps could be filled.
